about: A Formula that calls a volatile function is recalculated in every recalculation, a Reference computed while it is evaluated is read as it stands after the recalculation, and NOW answers the moment the host gives it (ADR-0124). Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' VolatileTests.

cases.name: ADR-0124: OFFSET reads a cell its text does not name, and follows a change to that cell
ADR-0124: a cell the same recalculation has still to compute is computed first, whatever the order

steps.note: B1 sorts before A6 in no order the graph knows: its text names A1, not A6.

cases.name: ADR-0124 / ADR-0047: a Formula that reaches itself through a computed Reference is #CIRC!
ADR-0124: OFFSET gives SUM a range whose size follows the data
ADR-0124: NOW answers the moment its host gives, read once per recalculation, and moves on with any change
ADR-0124: moving the clock on recalculates the volatile Formulas and what reads them, and nothing else
ADR-0124: without a moment, NOW waits, and a Formula that calls it waits whichever branch it takes
ADR-0124: a Sheet with no volatile Formula is not recalculated by the clock
